lines.text: The beetles lean on each other at dusk. I wrote it down. It is not in my brief.
I put the cull in my log with a margin note. A long one.
The pylon faulted. Nobody has ever checked a fault twice. Do not make them start.
Your crew has a Dominion contract on file. I am sorry. It colors how people talk to you.
The Keth well. You patched it. That went in the margin, too.
